title: Kingdom of Christ
definition: The kingdom of Christ is His saving reign as the promised King who rules His people now and will bring His kingdom to final fullness.
summary: Jesus reigns as King, and His kingdom is present now and coming in fullness.
christFocus: Christ is the King who brings righteousness, peace, salvation, judgment, and restoration.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christ's kingdom is not built by worldly pride or force. It is the reign of the crucified and risen King who saves sinners and gathers a people under His lordship.

The kingdom is already present because Christ reigns, yet believers still await its final visible fullness when He returns.

The kingdom of Christ calls for repentance, faith, allegiance, mission, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often reduce Christ's kingdom to politics, private spirituality, or future hope only. This doctrine matters because Jesus reigns now and will reign openly forever.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as a citizen of Christ's kingdom. Seek His righteousness, obey His authority, and proclaim His reign with hope.

relatedTopics: Resurrection, Ascension, and Return of Christ
